purpose: Fail-closed checks for customer-facing release artifacts. This policy protects distribution boundaries; it does not claim local code is impossible to reverse engineer.
notes: formal/** is prohibited from ordinary customer application artifacts; separately contracted proof deliverables require a different allowlisted export policy.

This initial policy does not ban all Python source because the current application packaging remains Python-based. Protected-core modules should receive explicit path bans as they migrate to native sealed packaging.
Customer releases should be built from an allowlist/staging directory rather than copying the repository wholesale.
